ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the figure is a bar chart of the national proportions of three freight transport modes in China’s Bohai Rim region, “Yangtze River Delta” region, Southwest region, and Northwest region. The legend includes railway transport, water transport, and road transport. In the “Southwest” group, the bar corresponding to road transport is clearly higher than railway transport and water transport, indicating that road transport is the most important freight transport mode in Southwest China. Reasoning: in Southwest China, mountains and plateaus are widespread, terrain relief is large, and terrain conditions are complex. The development of railway and water transport is restricted, while road transport has stronger adaptability, so one of the main influencing factors is terrain.
